description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget that displays log messages. It implements the LogNode interface and formats various log data, including message, priority, and exceptions, for display in a TextView.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting log details and managing log display.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data (priority, tag, message, throwable) into a string and appends it to the LogView UI, forwarding the log to the next node if exists.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
